seoTitle: Choropleth World Map Maker from a CSV (SVG)
metaDescription: Colour countries by values from a CSV using names or ISO codes, with classed legend and table. Shapes are bundled, nothing is fetched.
intro: Shades a world map by value for each country you list, with classes, a legend and a table of matches.
why:
Paste country and value rows and get a map. Names, ISO 2-letter and ISO 3-letter codes are matched, with a list of common alternative names. Anything that cannot be matched is listed so you can fix the spelling.

The shapes are Natural Earth 1:110m, public domain, stored on the site; small countries and islands are missing at this scale, so they cannot be coloured. Choose equal-interval or quantile classes and the colour scale. Colour alone is not enough, so the table has every value.
howTo: Choose the colour scale, the number of classes and the break method.
Check the unmatched list in the note.

faq.a: English short names, ISO codes and many variants such as USA, UK or Ivory Coast.

faq.q: Why is a small country missing?

faq.a: Quantile gives each colour the same number of countries; equal interval keeps value gaps even.
It is plate carree (plain latitude and longitude), which stretches areas near the poles.
